title: Private doctors pile titles: Viegas, Voragine, Costerus, Salazar, Mendoza—Queen by natural maternal right
source_text: LXIII. Privati vero Doctores certatim conantur istis elogiis aliquid addere, novasque laudes, ac novos titulos excogitant, quibus Beatam Virginem extollant. Sic Viegas in Apocalypsin dicit illam esse principem & dominam omnium creaturarum. Jacobus de Voragine illam in coelo, in mundo, & in inferno dominari. Costerus illam esse Reginarum Reginam, & absolute Reginam appellari tanquam omnium locorum, & omnium creaturarum. Qui sub nomine Anselmi de Beatae Virginis Excellentiis scripsit, Mariam esse Dominam summam, & unicam Dominatricem coeli & terrae. Salazar vero Jesuita Virginem Deiparam vere & proprie, & non per similitudinem Reginam & supernam Imperatricem esse, ex eo quia mater est summi Regis & Imperatoris rerum omnium: non electione aliqua aut privilegio, sed jure ipso naturali. Mendoza similiter hoc Virginis imperium, non esse Metaphoricum sed proprium ac Germanum, ex materna dignitate deductum. Nec solum illam esse Reginam orbis, sed orbis Reges facere. Denique jam dictus Salazar illam esse Reginam ob politicum & civile imperium: Dominam ob directum dominium rerum omnium, & Heram ob potestatem in servos & mancipia. Eamque jure divino spirituale animarum imperium adeptam esse.
pass_a_gloss: But private Doctors eagerly strive to add something to those eulogies, and invent new praises and new titles by which to extol the Blessed Virgin. Thus Viegas on the Apocalypse says that she is prince and lady of all creatures. Jacobus de Voragine that she rules in heaven, in the world, and in hell. Costerus that she is Queen of Queens, and is called absolutely Queen as of all places and of all creatures. He who wrote under the name of Anselm on the Excellencies of the Blessed Virgin, that Mary is the highest Lady and unique Dominatrix of heaven and earth. But Salazar the Jesuit that the Virgin Mother of God is truly and properly, and not by likeness, Queen and heavenly Empress, from this that she is mother of the highest King and Emperor of all things: not by some election or privilege, but by natural right itself. Mendoza likewise that this empire of the Virgin is not Metaphorical but proper and genuine, drawn from maternal dignity. And not only that she is Queen of the world, but that she makes the Kings of the world. Finally the already named Salazar that she is Queen by reason of political and civil empire: Lady by reason of direct dominion of all things, and Mistress by reason of power over servants and bondservants. And that by divine right she has obtained spiritual empire over souls.
pass_b_english: Private doctors escalate: prince of all creatures; ruler in heaven, world, and hell; Queen of Queens.
Salazar/Mendoza: proper Queen and Empress by natural maternal right—not metaphor—plus spiritual empire over souls.
